plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: Registry-only authorization package; authenticated human attestation is the later C3-3 target, not a prerequisite for this bootstrap step.
plan.rollback: Close or revert this staging-only registry authorization if the future verifier blob changes before installation.
unverified: The preauthorized verifier is not trusted until a later fresh PR changes the contracted file to the exact preauthorized blob and returns registry transitionPolicy to steady.
plan.problem: C3-3 needs authenticated human attestation logic, but change-verification-check.cjs is protected by the C3-2 exact-blob contract and cannot be changed safely without prior base-owned authorization.
plan.currentContract: staging/main is steady and the base-owned registry expects tools/change-verification-check.cjs blob e207027a3a59a0261f4b303fe8b9fcb86a8d2b30.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: The current verifier accepts candidate-authored recordedBy/manualChecks strings and has no trusted GitHub event attestation parser. Installing such parser in the same PR that authorizes its blob would violate the exact-blob transition model.
plan.design: Use the C3-2 steady-to-pending authorization path. Registry expectedBlob for tools/change-verification-check.cjs becomes the already-materialized future blob 114c0b2374361fc85fc487ed9bb6382564cc9fd8 while the repository file remains at the current fromBlob. A later fresh PR installs exactly that blob and returns the registry to steady.
alternativesRejected: Modify the verifier and registry in one PR; base-owned exact-blob enforcement intentionally forbids same-PR self-authorization.
Add a new uncontracted trusted attestation tool; that would create a security-critical executable outside the exact-blob contract set.
Skip preauthorization because the change is additive; C3-2 explicitly requires contracted security-critical file changes to use the transition protocol.
plan.migration: No existing Verification Record or evidence is rewritten. This PR only creates a temporary pending registry state for one contracted path.
plan.compatibility: No workflow, verifier runtime, required status name, Plan schema, or production behavior changes in this package.
boundaryCases: The target file must remain at fromBlob throughout the authorization PR.
Only tools/change-verification-check.cjs may differ between fromBlob and toBlob in transition metadata.
The future toBlob is fixed before Plan Lock and must not be recomputed from candidate code during trusted execution.
Candidate registry changes remain inert for the current PR because the trusted runner uses the PR-base registry.
